questions.explanation:
[Ru(en)3 ]Cl2 :

Here CN = 6 so octahedral splitting happens.

'en' is strong field ligand so 0 > P(pairing energy). That is why pairing of electrons happens.

0 = Energy gap between eg and t2g orbital.


[Fe(H2O)6]Cl2 :

Here CN = 6 so octahedral splitting happens.

H2O is weak field ligand so 0 < P(pairing energy). That is why no pairing of electrons happens.

0 = Energy gap between eg and t2g orbital.
